desc_en: Awaken your senses with our exclusive single origin Brazilian blend. Roasted using a sophisticated split-roast procedure to highlight complex flavor profiles. Deep notes of cocoa powder, caramel, and nuts. Intense body and balanced acidity to elevate your daily ritual. Each batch is made to order to ensure ultimate freshness in every cup. Available with worldwide shipping.

Notas profundas de cacao en polvo, caramelo y nueces. Cuerpo intenso y acidez equilibrada para acompañar tu rutina diaria. Cada lote se elabora bajo demanda para garantizar la máxima frescura en cada taza. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
